Subject: KMS/HSM evidence: scoped rotation snapshots & transit handshake (MeridianHealth)

Hi Lucas —

Thanks again for the call yesterday. To keep the SOC2/SIG intake moving, can you confirm Meridian can provide the following artifacts for the scoped tenant (account: meridian-prod-01)? We want an initial handoff that shows the rotation/transport chain and a small sampling of HSM attestations so our auditors can validate controls without needing full production dumps. Specifically we need: 

- Rotation snapshots (JSON/log extracts) for two recent rekeys (KEK wrapping events) including timestamps, operator id, and HSM slot ids (redact operator emails if required).
- A signed HSM attestation or audit seal for the period that covers those rotations (PDF or signed statement).
- TLS cipher inventory for the endpoints used for both internal transport and public-facing APIs during the rotation window.
- Sample wrapped KEK unwrap test vector (one short vector we can use to verify wrapping/unwrapping without exposing key material).
- Proof of transit: SCP/SFTP transfer manifest or signed S3 PUT logs demonstrating transfer of the rotated material to your archival bucket.

We can accept redacted operator identifiers and anonymized operator notes; auditors prefer intact slot ids/serials and timestamps. If you have a landing SFTP or temporary Share link, we can pull artifacts directly; otherwise we can provide an upload token.

Attached is a short checklist (redwood_rotation_requirements.pdf) for reference and a sample index we use (meridian_sample_index.csv) — fill the index with the filenames you plan to deliver.

Please advise if Meridian’s legal/security team needs a narrow NDA amendment for exporting these artifacts. If we can get initial samples by EOD Nov 9, we can slot the review with the auditor the week of Nov 15.

Thanks — short bullets for what to expect from our side: we will only request the specific log excerpts above (no full key material), we will use ephemeral accounts to pull artifacts, and we will run unwrap test vectors in our staging HSM emulator.

Best,
Sean
Director, Customer Security
Redwood Inference

Sean —

Appreciate the clear list. We can provide the rotation snapshots and the signed HSM attestation for the two rekeys requested, plus S3 PUT logs for transfers. A few clarifying points: 

1) Operator identifiers: we will redact PII (emails) but will keep operator role/title and an anonymized operator id (op-###). Hope that works for audit purposes.
2) HSM attestation: our HSM vendor provides a PKCS#7 signed attestation PDF (we'll include the chain).
3) Wrapped KEK test vector: we can provide a deterministic, short test vector (AES block) that demonstrates wrap/unwrap without exposing keys. We'll document the unwrap steps for the auditor.
4) Transfer proof: we can provide signed S3 logs or an SFTP manifest—we prefer S3 logs for immutable timestamps.

We do have a legal redaction checklist; we're fine with the scope you outlined but need a short transfer agreement to cover temporary artifact access (standard for regulated customers). If you can send a one-paragraph transfer approval email from Redwood legal (copy of the standard paragraph is fine), our security team will approve.

We will upload an initial bundle to a secure SFTP location. I'll send the invite details once the security team confirms the transfer agreement (should be 1–2 business days). Expected ETA for the sample bundle: Nov 9 (EOD) in UTC-5.

Files to expect: meridian_rotation_snapshot_20261012.json (redacted logs), meridian_hsm_attestation_20261012.pdf, meridian_s3_puts_20261012.log, meridian_wraptest_vector.hex
